detail.runner_up_case: NO_ADVERSE is very hard to reach honestly, but its strongest case runs as follows. (1) Identity is well established and clean on its face: SIGNA Holding GmbH, FN 191343m, Maria-Theresien-Straße 31, 6020 Innsbruck, the René Benko real-estate group (Wikidata Q1422071), with no adverse register notation yet verified from a primary record. (2) Every insolvency item in the file is secondary journalism (DW, Investing.com, Financier Worldwide, Wikipedia, a law-firm blog); no court docket, official Firmenbuch extract, or edikte/insolvenz gazette notice has been pulled, so the single material adverse fact rests entirely on press reports. (3) The November 2023 filing was a self-administered restructuring (Sanierungsverfahren mit Eigenverwaltung) — under Austrian law a debtor-in-possession reorganization, not a court-ordered Konkurs or liquidation — and if it concluded with an approved quota settlement the holding arguably avoided 'bankruptcy' in the strict sense. (4) Much of the reported distress (Signa Prime Selection AG, Signa Development Selection AG, Galeria, Signa Retail) attaches to subsidiaries, not the holding itself, and subsidiary distress is not automatically a material fact against the subject. The case nonetheless fails the rubric: 'insolvency' and restructuring/creditor-protection proceedings are expressly material, multiple independent outlets corroborate that Signa Holding GmbH itself filed in late November 2023, and a past insolvency remains a material adverse fact even if the proceedings were later concluded or the company rehabilitated. NO_ADVERSE is therefore at best a technical argument that the rubric rejects.
would_flip_it: An official Firmenbuch extract for FN 191343m or a Vienna Commercial Court record showing that no insolvency or restructuring proceeding was ever opened against SIGNA Holding GmbH itself — e.g., the November 2023 application was withdrawn or rejected before opening, or the proceeding was annulled (aufgehoben).

Credible primary evidence that the November 2023 filing was made by a different legal entity (a namesake, or only subsidiaries such as Signa Prime Selection AG), with the holding itself never entering proceedings.
An authoritative correction or retraction from the primary reporting outlets establishing that the reported insolvency of Signa Holding GmbH was erroneous.

Register evidence that the subject is a namesake — a different Firmenbuch entity than the René Benko group (different FN number or registered office) — which would detach the insolvency reporting from the subject.
